rules.title: Declare image content description intent
rules.mechanism: An exact governed Image call omits the contentDescription named argument.
rules.suggestion: Provide meaningful text, or use explicit null only when the image is decorative.
supportedSyntax: Exact unaliased com.viewcompose.ui.foundation.Image import with a balanced argument list.
Exact unaliased Image import followed by an explicit contentDescription named argument.
unsupportedSyntax: Import aliases, star imports, custom wrappers, malformed calls, and inferred overloads.

rules.title: Declare the exact owning ViewCompose artifact
rules.mechanism: An exact governed import resolves to an owning artifact absent from literal dependency declarations in the scanned scope.
rules.suggestion: Declare the owning artifact explicitly or include the Gradle file that declares it.
supportedSyntax: Exact governed imports and literal com.viewcompose dependency declarations in the scanned scope.
unsupportedSyntax: Transitive dependency inference, convention plugins, and dynamic dependency expressions.

rules.title: Reject unknown ViewCompose artifact coordinates
rules.mechanism: A literal com.viewcompose coordinate names an artifact absent from the active exact Knowledge profile.
rules.suggestion: Correct the coordinate or install the AI tooling profile that exactly matches the project framework release.
supportedSyntax: Literal Gradle string, module/name table, or current-project ViewCompose coordinates.
unsupportedSyntax: Computed group or artifact names, plugin-owned declarations, and nonliteral catalog expressions.

rules.title: Reject unknown ViewCompose namespaces
rules.mechanism: An exact import under the reserved com.viewcompose namespace is absent from the active exact Knowledge profile.
rules.suggestion: Use a governed current-profile symbol or align the AI tooling with the project framework release.
supportedSyntax: Exact unaliased Kotlin or Java import under com.viewcompose with a known or unknown namespace.
unsupportedSyntax: Import aliases, star imports, generated imports, and custom source preprocessors.

rules.title: Keep framework dependencies on the active exact profile
rules.mechanism: A literal released ViewCompose dependency version differs from the active exact Knowledge profile.
rules.suggestion: Install the exact tooling profile for this framework release or upgrade the framework separately before reinitializing tooling.
supportedSyntax: Literal released versions on known com.viewcompose artifacts.
unsupportedSyntax: Dynamic, catalog-referenced, conflicting, or otherwise unresolved version expressions.
